officialText:
Section 625.1 – Add Informational Note No. 3 at the end of Section 625.1 to read as follows:

Informational Note No.3: See Section 406 of the New York City Building Code for additional requirements to support Electric Vehicle Charging Stations for open and enclosed public parking garages and open parking lots. Refer to the New York City Energy Conservation Code, and Section 28-315 of the Administrative Code for additional requirements regarding electrical vehicle charging stations.
